name: st0-engine
description: Headless C++ audio engine (Tracktion + IXWebSocket). Receives a compiled ProjectDoc over WebSocket, plays audio, pushes transport and meter state back. Never parses song files.

scripts.test:mac: cmake --preset macos-clang && cmake --build build/macos-clang --target studio_engine_tests && ctest --test-dir build/macos-clang -R studio_engine_tests --output-on-failure
